🏡 REAL ESTATE AUCTION THIS THURSDAY 🏡

70 Bedsaul Rd, Galax, VA

This completely remodeled 2 bedroom, 1 bath home sits on 0.31 acres with a creek running along the front of the property. It has about 800 sq ft of updated living space, a new mini-split for heating and cooling, and a covered front porch. It's move-in ready and works well as a first home, a downsize or a rental.

• 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, approx. 800 sq ft
• 0.31 acres with creek frontage
• New mini-split heat and air
• Knotty pine walls and ceilings, new flooring
• Stainless appliances and laundry hookups

It sells online to the high bidder Thursday night.

Online real estate auction: Thursday, November 19 at 6 PM ET. All bidding is online at MatthewsAuctioneers.com. A 10% buyer's premium is added to the high bid, and a $5,000 earnest money deposit is due on sale day. 2% broker participation is offered when the buyer is registered in writing before the auction. Questions? Call Stephen LaRaviere, (276) 235-0153.
